Subject: MAP Kickoff: Aligning Executive Sponsors, Evaluation Plan & Escalation Paths

Hi Tom & Laura —

Thanks again for the time this week. As discussed in the demo, we think a short, structured mutual action plan (MAP) will help get the right stakeholders aligned and keep to the Q2 close timeline you mentioned. I’m looping in the Redwood leads who will own the technical evaluation, commercial terms, and the MAP ops cadence.

Proposed objectives for this kickoff email (so everyone is on the same page):
- Confirm executive sponsors and single points of contact for each stream (Product, Security, Procurement).
- Share an initial evaluation plan and success criteria (attached).
- Define escalation path and SLAs for blocker resolution during evaluation.
- Agree on key milestones and a target close date (we heard: end of Q2).

Immediate asks from Acme: please confirm the Exec sponsor (VP/CTO level) who will commit to the MAP outcomes and the procurement owner who will lead contract logistics.

Next steps from Redwood: we attached AMCE_MAP_v1 (MAP template) and a suggested evaluation checklist. I’ll propose two 30-minute alignment slots next week for sponsors and the technical owners.

Attachments: [Attachment: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx (Excel, 48KB)], [Attachment: Evaluation_Criteria.docx (Docx, 12KB)]

Thanks — looking forward to aligning on owners and timelines.

Best,
Neha Kapoor

Thanks for the loop — a few technical clarifications and proposed acceptance gates for the MAP checklist:

Acceptance gates (technical) — suggested:
1) Integration: successful end-to-end API integration with staging within 2 business days of providing API keys.
2) Performance: p95 latency target <= 350ms for 512-token inference on our recommended model variant.
3) Quality: evaluation set BLEU/Rouge-style pass rates (we’ll share a lightweight eval harness).
4) Security/compliance: agreement on KMS key ownership and that no customer PII is persisted in Redwood-hosted logs (we can provide architecture note).

Escalation path (proposed):
- Day-0 blocker: Redwood AEs & Acme dev leads (Rishi <-> Acme SRE)
- Day-2 unresolved: Neha (AE) escalate to Marissa (Head of Sales Ops) and Tom (CTO)
- Day-5 unresolved: VP-level sync: Laura (VP Product) with Marissa and our Head of Solutions (cc’d on future notes)

I’ll attach a short technical appendix after the sponsor call that lists the test harness and suggested evaluation scripts. For the model quantization gate — we recommend starting with a float16 variant and only switching to quantized variants after a quality regression check; we’ll include a step in the MAP for a quantization regression test.

If Tom & Laura confirm 3/27 9:00am PT, I’ll block a technical 30-min pre-call with Acme devs on 3/26 so we can prepare the staging keys and test prompts.

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
